description: Proves the domain belongs to a Pidgeon account, so websites can see which domain stands behind that account's AI agents, and lets Pidgeon sign those agents' Agent-of email declaration as the domain. One TXT record at _pidgeon, and one CNAME at pgn2._domainkey pointing at Pidgeon's agent key.
variableDescription: token: 32 lowercase hex characters, issued by Pidgeon for this domain.
